Package com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax

Class SharedJmsReceiver

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.AbstractReceiver
      • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.AbstractJmsReceiver
        • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.JmsReceiver
          • com.im.njams.sdk.communication.jms.javax.SharedJmsReceiver
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    SenderRecoveryListener, ShareableReceiver<javax.jms.Message>, javax.jms.ExceptionListener, javax.jms.MessageListener
    @Deprecated(since="6.1.0")
public class SharedJmsReceiver
extends JmsReceiver
implements ShareableReceiver<javax.jms.Message>
    Deprecated.
    Since 6.1.0 in favour of the jakarta.jms based shared receiver SharedJmsReceiver. This javax.jms implementation stays supported and is not scheduled for removal.
    Overrides the common JmsReceiver for supporting receiving messages for multiple Njams instances.
    Author:
    cwinkler

      • removeNjams

        @Deprecated(since="6.1.0")
public boolean removeNjams​(Njams njamsInstance)
        Deprecated.
        See SharedJmsReceiver.
        Stops the given Njams instance from receiving messages from this receiver instance.
        Specified by:
        removeNjams in interface ShareableReceiver<javax.jms.Message>
        Parameters:
